prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.0 °C (64% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.9 °C (55% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.4 °C (48% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.59 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.7 bar (2% below healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
